author: KroestV2
body:
You are pushing us all to vote for that list, we got pretty high, but after checking out the list, i think you can do a way better job regarding the banner.

This is the current banner:



The banner doesn't give any information about why someone should join the server, and doesn't tell the user why the Avicus is so unique (teambased pvp!!?!??!), while other big networks nicely list their coolest gamemodes. Please, update this banner so you actually make the user curious, and increase the chance of players joining.
